providers.name: Gmail
providers.authHint: App Password of a Google account with 2-Step Verification, or an OAuth 2.0 access token
providers.notes: SMTP also accepts STARTTLS on port 587. Folders live under the [Gmail] namespace and roles come from SPECIAL-USE. The server advertises UTF8=ACCEPT but answers BAD Could not parse command to any SEARCH with non-ASCII text once the extension is enabled, so the plugin never enables it and searches with CHARSET UTF-8 (verified 2026-09-20). Custom IMAP keywords are stored. IDLE reports new mail about 30 s after delivery. The server copies of sent mail in [Gmail]/Sent Mail can be addressed by UID. The POP3 view does not include mail the account has just sent.

providers.name: Outlook.com
providers.authHint: OAuth 2.0 access token; Outlook.com no longer accepts passwords for IMAP, POP3 and SMTP
providers.notes: Personal Microsoft accounts. IMAP advertises LOGINDISABLED and only AUTH=XOAUTH2, and IMAP, POP3 and SMTP all refuse an app password (Basic authentication is disabled, SMTP 535; three accounts, 2026-09-20): an access token is required.

providers.name: Microsoft 365
providers.authHint: OAuth 2.0 access token; a tenant may still allow a password for SMTP submission only
providers.notes: Work or school accounts; tenant policy may disable IMAP, POP3 or SMTP AUTH entirely.

providers.name: QQ Mail
providers.authHint: Authorization code generated in the QQ Mail settings, not the account password
providers.notes: Text SEARCH with non-ASCII arguments answers OK with no hits instead of an error, so the default fallback 'client' never triggers: search Chinese text with fallback 'always'. The server rewrites the Message-ID of outgoing mail (a search by messageId finds nothing) and the ENVELOPE To display name (the raw To header keeps the sent one). IMAP CREATE is refused, or the folder vanishes within seconds; the copies the server files in Sent Messages for SMTP-sent mail are listed but stay unaddressable by UID for a while (UID FETCH answers OK without data, STORE answers NO System busy!). Custom keywords are accepted but not stored. IMAP IDLE is accepted but the server pushes nothing while a client idles (verified 2026-09-19: no untagged response within 10 minutes of a delivery, after SELECT or EXAMINE), so watches poll unless mode 'idle' is asked for; new mail becomes visible to a fresh EXAMINE 15-40 s after delivery.

providers.name: 163 Mail
providers.authHint: Authorization code from the 163 Mail settings (POP3/SMTP/IMAP page), not the account password
providers.notes: The IMAP server answers Unsafe Login to SELECT and EXAMINE on every connection that has not sent the ID command; the plugin identifies each connection it opens. The server keeps a copy of every message sent through SMTP in the sent folder (it appears with a delay of up to a few minutes), and text SEARCH (SUBJECT, FROM, BODY, HEADER Message-ID) answers OK without hits for recent mail while SINCE works: search with fallback 'always'. Spaces in the sender display name come back as underscores. Custom keywords are accepted but not stored. The IMAP server has no IDLE (the command answers BAD), so watches poll. yeah.net uses the same servers policy on imap / pop / smtp.yeah.net (its IMAP does advertise IDLE).

providers.name: 126 Mail
providers.authHint: Authorization code from the 126 Mail settings (POP3/SMTP/IMAP page), not the account password
providers.notes: Same servers policy as 163 Mail: every IMAP connection has to send the ID command before SELECT or EXAMINE; the plugin identifies each connection it opens. The server keeps a copy of every message sent through SMTP in the sent folder (verified with a real account). Text SEARCH answered correctly, including Chinese subjects, in the 2026-09-19 matrix, unlike 163; use fallback 'always' when a search must not miss recent mail. Spaces in the sender display name come back as underscores. Custom keywords are accepted but not stored. The IMAP server has no IDLE (the command answers BAD), so watches poll.

providers.name: Yahoo Mail
providers.authHint: App password generated in the Yahoo account security settings
providers.notes: SMTP also accepts STARTTLS on port 587. Unverified against a real account (none is available to the project): autoSavesSent and the sent folder follow Yahoo's public documentation.

providers.name: Sina Mail
providers.authHint: Authorization code from the Sina Mail client settings
providers.notes: The server does not keep a copy of mail sent through SMTP (the plugin appends one to the sent folder), and it answers NO to every IMAP CREATE: folders can only be made in the web UI, so createFolder fails with SERVER_ERROR. IMAP SEARCH accepts only ALL, SINCE and flag keys; every text key (SUBJECT, FROM, BODY, TEXT, HEADER) answers BAD, so text searches always run on the client (the default fallback). Folder roles come from the folder names (no SPECIAL-USE or XLIST). Custom keywords are accepted but not stored. IMAP IDLE is not advertised; the command is accepted but nothing is pushed and the server closes the connection after 60 s of idling (verified 2026-09-19), so watches poll.

providers.name: Aliyun Mail
providers.authHint: Account password of a personal Aliyun Mail account
providers.notes: Personal edition. Unverified against a real account (none is available to the project): the server-side sent copy is unconfirmed, so autoSavesSent stays false and no sent folder is named.
